_comment: The ONE model Prism calls. It routes, it never answers — it reads a question and decides which of the student's browser AIs is best placed to answer it. Routing is a small classification job, so prefer FAST INSTRUCT models over reasoning models: a reasoning model spends thirty seconds deliberating over a five-way label choice.
_free_model_note: `models` is an OpenRouter-specific ordered fallback list: it tries each in turn IN ONE REQUEST and bills nothing for :free variants, so a model that is down or rate-limited costs a few hundred ms rather than a failed run. FREE MODEL IDS ROTATE CONSTANTLY — verify this list at https://openrouter.ai/models?q=free and prune anything 404ing. Free tier is ~20 req/min and 50 req/day, rising to 1000/day once the account has $10 of lifetime credit.
_router_fallbacks_note: Tried only if OpenRouter itself is unreachable or keyless. All optional — with no keys at all, routing falls back to keywords and the product still works.
